sections.heading: Differentiation & Rates of Change Practice Exercises

questions.q: Differentiate with respect to \( x \): \( y = 3x^{3} - 5x + 7 \).
questions.answer: Apply the power rule \( \frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = n x^{n-1} \): \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 3(3)x^{2} - 5 = 9x^{2} - 5 \).

questions.q: Differentiate with respect to \( x \): \( y = 6x^{4} - 5x + 7 \).
questions.answer: Apply the power rule \( \frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = n x^{n-1} \): \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 6(4)x^{3} - 5 = 24x^{3} - 5 \).

questions.q: Differentiate with respect to \( x \): \( y = 9x^{5} - 5x + 7 \).
questions.answer: Apply the power rule \( \frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = n x^{n-1} \): \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 9(5)x^{4} - 5 = 45x^{4} - 5 \).

questions.q: Differentiate with respect to \( x \): \( y = 12x^{6} - 5x + 7 \).
questions.answer: Apply the power rule \( \frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = n x^{n-1} \): \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 12(6)x^{5} - 5 = 72x^{5} - 5 \).

questions.q: Differentiate with respect to \( x \): \( y = 15x^{7} - 5x + 7 \).
questions.answer: Apply the power rule \( \frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = n x^{n-1} \): \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 15(7)x^{6} - 5 = 105x^{6} - 5 \).

questions.q: Differentiate with respect to \( x \): \( y = 18x^{8} - 5x + 7 \).
questions.answer: Apply the power rule \( \frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = n x^{n-1} \): \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 18(8)x^{7} - 5 = 144x^{7} - 5 \).

questions.q: Find the equation of the tangent line to the curve \( y = (2x + 1)^3 \) at the point where \( x = 0 \).
questions.answer: At \( x = 0 \), \( y = 1^3 = 1 \). Derivative: \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 3(2x+1)^2 \cdot (2) = 6(2x+1)^2 \). At \( x = 0 \), slope \( m = 6 \). Equation: \( y - 1 = 6(x - 0) \implies y = 6x + 1 \).

questions.q: Find the equation of the tangent line to the curve \( y = (3x + 1)^3 \) at the point where \( x = 0 \).
questions.answer: At \( x = 0 \), \( y = 1^3 = 1 \). Derivative: \( \frac{dy}{dx} = 3(3x+1)^2 \cdot (3) = 9(3x+1)^2 \). At \( x = 0 \), slope \( m = 9 \). Equation: \( y - 1 = 9(x - 0) \implies y = 9x + 1 \).
